1.name: The Creative

reading.scene: Clear sky without clouds — the situation is open, with no hidden obstacles.
reading.dynamics: Pure activity, without reliance on external conditions. Force moves top down, without counter-pressure.
reading.vector: Vertical axis: leadership without counterweight. The system is homogeneous; all lines are active.

1.judgment: Creative potential brings success through persistence.
1.image: Heaven moves strong and steadfast — thus the wise person strengthens themselves continuously.

2.name: The Receptive

reading.scene: Earth holds moisture — stable, cool, without sharp changes.
reading.dynamics: Passive support. Activity is external; the inner structure receives and distributes.
reading.vector: Horizontal plane: foundation on which action is built. Counterweight to heaven.

2.judgment: The Receptive brings success through the consistency of a mare.
2.image: The state of earth is receptivity. A wide space open for formation.

3.name: Difficulty at the Beginning

reading.scene: Storm on the horizon — energy accumulated but not yet discharged.
reading.dynamics: Thunder under Water: movement meets resistance. Impulse exists, the channel not yet cut.
reading.vector: Bifurcation point — the system between two modes, unstable.

3.judgment: Difficulty at the beginning brings great significance. Do not hurry.
3.image: Clouds and thunder — thus the wise person brings order to confusion.

4.name: Youthful Folly

reading.scene: Mist over the spring — visibility limited, structure not yet manifest.
reading.dynamics: Water over Mountain: the flow has not yet found its path. A teacher is needed, not force.
reading.vector: Closed system with one outlet — knowledge not yet structured.

4.judgment: Youthful folly is not error but a state requiring clarification.
4.image: The spring beside the mountain — thus the wise person awakens people to self-knowledge.

5.name: Waiting

reading.scene: Clouds gather, rain has not yet fallen — tension before discharge.
reading.dynamics: Heaven over Water: potential high above, realization below. Gap between possible and actual.
reading.vector: Vertical gap between levels — the system in waiting mode, not action.

5.judgment: Waiting with confidence. Strength in patience, not in forcing.
5.image: Clouds rise toward heaven — thus the wise person eats and drinks, rejoices and stays calm.

6.name: Conflict

reading.scene: Heaven and Earth diverge — atmosphere of tense polarization.
reading.dynamics: Heaven over Water: assertion from above meets resistance below. Force vectors diverge.
reading.vector: Diametrical opposition — the system in internal friction without synthesis.

6.judgment: Conflict. Do not force victory — half a victory is enough.
6.image: Heaven and water move in different directions.

7.name: The Army

reading.scene: Earth beneath water — hidden depth, resources gathered under the surface.
reading.dynamics: Water over Earth: collective energy with organizational support. Structure plus mass.
reading.vector: Hierarchical system: vertical command over horizontal body.

7.judgment: The Army requires discipline and a just commander.
7.image: Water within the earth — thus the wise person supports people without tiring.

8.name: Holding Together

reading.scene: Morning dew on earth — soft joining of elements.
reading.dynamics: Water over Earth, but in another configuration: attraction, not subjugation.
reading.vector: Network of connections — horizontal coalition with vertical core.

8.judgment: Holding together. First the call — then the test of loyalty.
8.image: Water on the earth — thus the wise person moves people toward unity.

9.name: Small Taming

reading.scene: Light wind beneath heaven — weak but steady influence.
reading.dynamics: Wind over Heaven: soft restraint of great power. Not blockage — channeling.
reading.vector: Partial control — the system restrained but not suppressed.

9.judgment: Small taming. Clouds without rain — form exists, substance not yet.
9.image: Wind moves across heaven — thus the wise person refines cultural forms.

10.name: Treading

reading.scene: Clear sky reflected in the lake — visibility and self-reflection.
reading.dynamics: Heaven over Lake: activity with caution. Force with moderated expression.
reading.vector: Path between two surfaces — movement along the thin line between action and self-observation.

10.judgment: Treading step by step. Caution on a dangerous path brings success.
10.image: Heaven and lake — thus the wise person distinguishes high and low.

11.name: Peace

reading.scene: Heaven and Earth draw near — warmth, moisture, exchange between levels.
reading.dynamics: Heaven over Earth in cooperation: activity above, receptivity below. Flows are free.
reading.vector: Open system with two-way exchange — optimal configuration.

11.judgment: Peace. The small departs, the great approaches.
11.image: Heaven and Earth unite — thus the wise person distributes wealth.

12.name: Standstill
12.composition: Heaven withdraws upward; earth settles downward.

reading.scene: Heaven and Earth do not communicate — dryness, absence of exchange.
reading.dynamics: Heaven withdraws from Earth. Activity and receptivity are disconnected.
reading.vector: Closed system — flows blocked, energy does not circulate.

12.judgment: Standstill. The great departs, the small approaches. Not the time for great undertakings.
12.image: Heaven and Earth separated — thus the wise person restrains their worth.

13.name: Fellowship

reading.scene: Sun over open space — visibility, warmth, gathering.
reading.dynamics: Heaven over Fire: light and warmth spread. The center attracts.
reading.vector: Radial structure — core with orbital connections.

13.judgment: Fellowship with people in the open. Broad, not narrow.
13.image: Heaven with fire — thus the wise person gathers people without prejudice.

14.name: Great Possession

reading.scene: Bright sun at zenith — maximum visibility and manifestation.
reading.dynamics: Fire over Heaven: light spreads upward and outward. Full expression.
reading.vector: Central dominance — one element holds the whole system.

14.judgment: Great Possession. Great attainment. Do not become arrogant.
14.image: Fire in heaven — thus the wise person suppresses evil and elevates good.

15.name: Modesty

reading.scene: The mountain lowers toward earth — greatness without domination.
reading.dynamics: Earth over Mountain: strength hidden beneath receptivity. Inversion of the expected.
reading.vector: Lowered center — weight distributed, not concentrated above.

15.judgment: Modesty brings success. The low is raised, the high is lowered.
15.image: Mountain under earth — thus the wise person reduces excess and fills lack.

16.name: Enthusiasm

reading.scene: Thunder rolls over earth — vibration that awakens.
reading.dynamics: Thunder over Earth: impulse from above activates receptivity below. Resonance.
reading.vector: Vertical channel of arousal — energy transmitted without blockage.

16.judgment: Enthusiasm. Useful to set commanders in place and move the army.
16.image: Thunder rises from earth — thus the wise person makes music and gives praise.

17.name: Following

reading.scene: The lake reflects thunder — reactivity, response to change.
reading.dynamics: Lake over Thunder: the soft follows the firm. Adaptation to movement.
reading.vector: Sequential pair — one leads, the other responds. Flexible structure.

17.judgment: Following brings success. Going out, rest, benefit.
17.image: Lake and thunder — thus the wise person rests and rejoices.

18.name: Work on the Decayed

reading.scene: Stagnant moisture under wind — something decays, but circulation returns.
reading.dynamics: Wind over Mountain: soft force works on a stagnant structure. Repair loop.
reading.vector: Degradation-renewal loop — the system needs intervention at points of decay.

18.judgment: Work on the decayed. Before action — three days of reflection, after — three days of joy.
18.image: Wind beside the mountain — thus the wise person awakens people to work on mistakes.

19.name: Approach

reading.scene: Spring sun over the lake — warmth approaches, ice melts.
reading.dynamics: Earth over Lake: receptivity above, joy below. Meeting of levels.
reading.vector: Convergent motion — two elements draw near, the zone of contact expands.

19.judgment: Approach. Great growth. But readiness for decline.
19.image: Earth over lake — thus the wise person teaches and supports without limit.

20.name: Contemplation

reading.scene: Wind passes over open field — overview without intervention.
reading.dynamics: Wind over Earth: observation from height. Action deferred on behalf of seeing.
reading.vector: Watchtower position — the system in monitoring mode, not acting.

20.judgment: Contemplation. The wise person clears themselves without moving.
20.image: Wind over earth — thus the wise person reviews and refines teaching.

21.name: Biting Through

reading.scene: Lightning and thunder simultaneously — sharp clarification.
reading.dynamics: Fire and Thunder: light plus strike. Force passes through the block.
reading.vector: Narrow obstacle between two active zones — a decisive cut is needed.

21.judgment: Biting through. Justice. The obstacle must be removed.
21.image: Thunder and lightning — thus the wise person clarifies laws.

22.name: Grace
22.composition: Fire at the foot of the mountain.

reading.scene: Sunset on the mountain — beauty without functional necessity.
reading.dynamics: Fire under Mountain: light hidden by form. Decoration over substance.
reading.vector: Surface layer — outer form does not change inner structure.

22.judgment: Grace. Small growth. Form, not essence.
22.image: Fire beside the mountain — thus the wise person refines outward forms.

23.name: Splitting Apart
23.composition: A mountain stands on earth, but the base is being stripped away.

reading.scene: The mountain washes away in rain — gradual erosion from above.
reading.dynamics: Mountain over Earth: the firm dissolves into the soft. Structural degradation.
reading.vector: Top-down decay — upper layers fall away, the foundation still holds.

23.judgment: Splitting apart. Not the time for movement. Preserve what remains.
23.image: Mountain on earth — thus the wise person strengthens the household through generosity.

24.name: Return

reading.scene: First spring thunder under earth — awakening after winter.
reading.dynamics: Thunder under Earth: impulse from depth. One active line returns.
reading.vector: Turning point — minimal activity starts the cycle of renewal.

24.judgment: Return. Going out and coming in without harm. Friends arrive without fault.
24.image: Thunder in earth — thus the wise person closes paths and opens time.

25.name: Innocence

reading.scene: Pure lightning without clouds — action without hidden motives.
reading.dynamics: Thunder under Heaven: natural impulse in accord with heaven. Without artifice.
reading.vector: Transparent system — no hidden layers or manipulation.

25.judgment: Innocence brings success. Only if action is genuine.
25.image: Thunder under heaven — thus the wise person lives without excess.

26.name: Great Taming

reading.scene: Clouds gather at the mountain — potential accumulated, not discharged.
reading.dynamics: Mountain under Heaven: great power restrained by form. Reservoir of power.
reading.vector: Compressed system — energy preserved, not spent.

26.judgment: Great taming. Find wisdom in what is accumulated.
26.image: Heaven in the mountains — thus the wise person learns words of the past.

27.name: Nourishment

reading.scene: Thunder echoes in the valley — resonance without visible source.
reading.dynamics: Thunder under Mountain: what enters and what exits — mouth, word, food.
reading.vector: Input/output gate — the system is defined by what enters it.

27.judgment: Nourishment. Caution with what you take in and what you release.
27.image: Thunder beside the mountain — thus the wise person is attentive to words.

28.name: Great Exceeding

reading.scene: Wind bends the tree over the lake — structure under extreme load.
reading.dynamics: Lake over Wind: joy over flexibility, but overload. Beam sagging.
reading.vector: Overextended span — center weak, edges strong. Structural stress.

28.judgment: Great exceeding. The beam sags. Extraordinary measures.
28.image: Lake and tree — thus the wise person stands alone, without support.

29.name: The Abysmal

reading.scene: Water over water — endless depth, repeated danger.
reading.dynamics: Doubled Water: risk that repeats. Not one obstacle — a pattern.
reading.vector: Vertical abyss — the system in recurring danger, not a linear obstacle.

29.judgment: The Abysmal. Loyalty and sincerity — the path through.
29.image: Water flowing — thus the wise person keeps the heart constant.

30.name: The Clinging

reading.scene: Sun at zenith — bright, but dependent on fuel.
reading.dynamics: Doubled Fire: clarity plus attachment. Light needs what it clings to.
reading.vector: Dual dependency — the system is bright but not autonomous.

30.judgment: Fire. Clarity. Dependence on what one clings to.
30.image: Two fires — thus the wise person continues the light of great people.

31.name: Influence

reading.scene: Dew on the peak — soft attraction between levels.
reading.dynamics: Lake over Mountain: soft above, firm below. Mutual influence.
reading.vector: Contact surface — two elements touch and resonate.

31.judgment: Influence. The soft prevails over the firm. Spontaneous response.
31.image: Lake on the mountain — thus the wise person receives through receptivity.

32.name: Duration

reading.scene: Constant wind and distant thunder — long-lasting pattern.
reading.dynamics: Thunder and Wind: movement plus penetration. Not burst — sustained motion.
reading.vector: Stable oscillation — the system in endurance mode, not transformation.

32.judgment: Duration. Consistency without change of direction.
32.image: Thunder and wind — thus the wise person stands without changing place.

33.name: Retreat

reading.scene: Heaven hides behind the mountain — visibility deliberately reduced.
reading.dynamics: Heaven under Mountain: force withdraws. Strategic withdrawal, not defeat.
reading.vector: Contraction — the system reduces exposure, preserves the core.

33.judgment: Retreat. Force is small, the obstacle is great. Preserve the essence.
33.image: Heaven in the mountains — thus the wise person keeps distance from the small.

34.name: Great Power

reading.scene: Powerful thunder under clear heaven — force without obstacles.
reading.dynamics: Thunder under Heaven: maximum activity. Power in motion.
reading.vector: Full extension — the system at peak output, without restraint.

34.judgment: Great power. Correctness. Force requires restraint.
34.image: Thunder under heaven — thus the wise person does not step beyond measure.

35.name: Progress
35.composition: The sun comes out over earth.

reading.scene: Sun rising over earth — growing visibility.
reading.dynamics: Fire over Earth: light rises. Clarity increases.
reading.vector: Ascending trajectory — the system moves toward greater exposure.

35.judgment: Progress. The prince receives honors. Growth of visibility.
35.image: Sun over earth — thus the wise person brings forth light themselves.

36.name: Darkening of the Light

reading.scene: Sun beneath earth — light hidden, not destroyed.
reading.dynamics: Fire under Earth: clarity suppressed. Intelligence under cover.
reading.vector: Inverted visibility — core active, surface passive. Hidden strength.

36.judgment: Darkening of the light. Fold the wings. Do not display brightness.
36.image: Sun in earth — thus the wise person endures without shining.

37.name: The Family

reading.scene: Fire in the house — warmth within walls.
reading.dynamics: Wind with Fire: penetration plus warmth. Internal organization.
reading.vector: Nested structure — roles defined, boundaries clear. Microcosm.

37.judgment: The Family. Woman within, man without. Correct roles.
37.image: Wind from fire — thus the wise person has substance in words.

38.name: Opposition

reading.scene: Sun and moon in the sky — both visible, but not together.
reading.dynamics: Fire and Lake: two directions. Coexistence without unity.
reading.vector: Parallel divergence — elements side by side, but not integrated.

38.judgment: Opposition. Small matters — success. Great ones — blockage.
38.image: Fire and lake — thus the wise person finds common ground.

39.name: Obstruction

reading.scene: Water at the peak — unnatural placement, stagnation.
reading.dynamics: Water over Mountain: flow blocked by form. Obstacle at the peak.
reading.vector: Blocked channel — energy accumulates before the barrier.

39.judgment: Obstruction. To south and north — success. Stop for reflection.
39.image: Water on the mountain — thus the wise person turns attention inward.

40.name: Deliverance

reading.scene: The storm passes — tension discharged, movement restored.
reading.dynamics: Thunder and Water: impulse releases blockage. Return to flow.
reading.vector: Opening after closure — the system exits a constrained state.

40.judgment: Deliverance. To the west and south — success. Return to norm.
40.image: Thunder and rain — thus the wise person forgives mistakes.

41.name: Decrease

reading.scene: The lake evaporates beside the mountain — reduction, concentration.
reading.dynamics: Lake under Mountain: decrease from above. Less becomes more focused.
reading.vector: Subtractive process — the system sheds excess, the core intensifies.

41.judgment: Decrease. Sincerity. Sacrifice lower for benefit higher.
41.image: Lake beside mountain — thus the wise person controls anger and restrains instinct.

42.name: Increase

reading.scene: Wind strengthens thunder — amplification, not origin.
reading.dynamics: Wind over Thunder: above strengthens below. Beneficial addition.
reading.vector: Positive feedback — the system gains without losing structure.

42.judgment: Increase. Beneficial to move. Great growth.
42.image: Wind and thunder — thus the wise person sees good and corrects.

43.name: Breakthrough

reading.scene: The lake rises toward heaven — tension before breakthrough.
reading.dynamics: Lake under Heaven: accumulated pressure seeks release. Decisive assertion.
reading.vector: Critical point — one line away from full yang. Positioning for breakthrough.

43.judgment: Breakthrough. Declaration in the square. Sincerity with caution.
43.image: Lake under heaven — thus the wise person informs, does not compel.

44.name: Coming to Meet

reading.scene: Wind appears under heaven — sudden, potentially invasive.
reading.dynamics: Wind under Heaven: one yin penetrates the yang field. External influence enters.
reading.vector: Infiltration point — weak line at bottom, strong field above.

44.judgment: Coming to meet. Not binding. Caution with the unexpected.
44.image: Wind under heaven — thus the wise person distributes mandates.

45.name: Gathering Together

reading.scene: Rain gathers in the lake on earth — accumulation point.
reading.dynamics: Lake over Earth: resources converge. Collective focus.
reading.vector: Convergence hub — multiple streams toward a single center.

45.judgment: Gathering together. Success. The king approaches the temple. The great gathers.
45.image: Lake on earth — thus the wise person eliminates weakness.

46.name: Pushing Upward

reading.scene: A plant breaks through earth — gradual upward motion.
reading.dynamics: Earth under Wind: receptivity supports penetration. Natural rise.
reading.vector: Vertical growth — bottom-up development, not forced.

46.judgment: Pushing upward. Great growth. Do not hurry.
46.image: Tree in earth — thus the wise person accumulates through small means.

47.name: Oppression

reading.scene: The lake has dried — resource depleted, structure without substance.
reading.dynamics: Lake trapped in Water: joy exhausted by danger. Depletion loop.
reading.vector: Empty container — form remains, function blocked. Exhaustion pattern.

47.judgment: Oppression. Words not believed. Yet the great person succeeds.
47.image: Lake without water — thus the wise person stakes life on conviction.

48.name: The Well

reading.scene: Invisible source beneath earth — constant resource, unchanging.
reading.dynamics: Wind over Water: circulation over depth. Infrastructure pattern.
reading.vector: Fixed source — the system centered on an unchanging resource. Community asset.

48.judgment: The Well. The town may change, the well does not.
48.image: Water over wood — thus the wise person supports people.

49.name: Revolution

reading.scene: Autumn change — the old is shed, the new not yet formed.
reading.dynamics: Lake and Fire: two incompatible elements. Structural transformation required.
reading.vector: Phase transition — the system between states, old skin shed.

49.judgment: Revolution. Sincerity. Great change — the time is right.
49.image: Fire in the lake — thus the wise person clarifies the calendar.

50.name: The Cauldron

reading.scene: Fire cooks in the cauldron — transformation through heat.
reading.dynamics: Fire over Wind: cooking, refinement. Raw becomes nourishing.
reading.vector: Vessel — container that transforms content. Cultural infrastructure.

50.judgment: The Cauldron. Great growth. Connection between heaven and earth.
50.image: Fire over wind — thus the wise person clarifies position.

51.name: The Arousing

reading.scene: Doubled thunder — shock that awakens, does not destroy.
reading.dynamics: Doubled Thunder: sudden activation. System jolted awake.
reading.vector: Pulse event — brief intense disruption, then new equilibrium.

51.judgment: Thunder brings success. Shock, then laughter. Spirit does not fall.
51.image: Thunder repeats — thus the wise person fears and is purified.

52.name: Keeping Still

reading.scene: Mountain — absolute stillness, not stagnation.
reading.dynamics: Doubled Mountain: complete stop. Meditation, not paralysis.
reading.vector: Fixed point — the system anchored, movement suspended.

52.judgment: Keeping still. The back does not move. The heart is not restless.
52.image: Mountain — thus the wise person does not think about what is outside their domain.

53.name: Development

reading.scene: Tree on the slope — slow but steady growth.
reading.dynamics: Wind over Mountain: penetration over time. Gradual penetration.
reading.vector: Slow trajectory — progress through patience, not force.

53.image: Tree on the mountain — thus the wise person lives in dignity.

54.name: The Marrying Maiden

reading.scene: Thunder over calm lake — action without proper foundation.
reading.dynamics: Thunder over Lake: impulse over joy. Wrong position, right energy.
reading.vector: Misaligned structure — function in improper role. Secondary position.

54.judgment: The marrying maiden. Undertakings — misfortune. Do not force a primary role.
54.image: Thunder over lake — thus the wise person understands misfortune.

55.name: Abundance

reading.scene: Sun at zenith — maximum brightness, shortest shadow.
reading.dynamics: Thunder and Fire: peak activity. Fullness before decline.
reading.vector: Maximum point — the system at height, decline inevitably follows.

55.judgment: Abundance. Be like noon. Do not grieve — rejoice.
55.image: Thunder and lightning — thus the wise person judges lawsuits.

56.name: The Wanderer

reading.scene: Fire on a foreign mountain — temporary shelter, no roots.
reading.dynamics: Fire over Mountain: light without foundation. Passing through.
reading.vector: Transient node — the system not anchored, between states.

56.judgment: The Wanderer. Success through smallness. Caution and modesty.
56.image: Fire on the mountain — thus the wise person is clear and cautious.

57.name: The Gentle

reading.scene: Wind penetrates everywhere — omnipresent, invisible force.
reading.dynamics: Doubled Wind: gentle but pervasive. Influence through subtlety.
reading.vector: Distributed network — force everywhere, center nowhere.

57.judgment: The Gentle. Success through small penetration.
57.image: Wind repeats — thus the wise person renews mandates.

58.name: The Joyous

reading.scene: Two lakes — mutual reflection, shared joy.
reading.dynamics: Doubled Lake: communication, pleasure. Open exchange.
reading.vector: Mirror pair — the system defined by reciprocal flow.

58.image: Lake repeats — thus the wise person joins with friends.

59.name: Dispersion

reading.scene: Wind disperses mist over water — dispersion, clearing.
reading.dynamics: Wind over Water: soft force dissolves hard accumulation.
reading.vector: Decentralization — cohesion lost, elements scatter.

59.judgment: Dispersion. Success. The king approaches the temple.
59.image: Wind over water — thus the wise person lets go of old anger.

60.name: Limitation

reading.scene: Water in a channel — flow defined by boundaries.
reading.dynamics: Water over Lake: limitation creates form. Measure enables function.
reading.vector: Bounded system — constraints define operational space.

60.image: Water over lake — thus the wise person creates measure.

61.name: Inner Truth

reading.scene: Wind over lake — surface reflects depth honestly.
reading.dynamics: Wind over Lake: inner and outer aligned. Sincerity as structure.
reading.vector: Transparent core — hollow center (only hexagram with both middle lines yin).

61.judgment: Inner truth. Pig and fish — good fortune. Trust moves.
61.image: Wind over lake — thus the wise person discusses criminal cases.

62.name: Small Exceeding

reading.scene: A bird flies low — excess in small things, not grand.
reading.dynamics: Thunder over Mountain: activity exceeds in the minor domain.
reading.vector: Overweight on small scale — detail over principle.

62.judgment: Small exceeding. Success. Not great affairs.
62.image: Thunder on the mountain — thus the wise person exceeds in reverence.

63.name: After Completion

reading.scene: Water and fire in balance — all lines in place, order achieved.
reading.dynamics: Water over Fire: perfect configuration. Yet instability inherent.
reading.vector: Completed structure — every position filled, but change imminent.

63.judgment: After completion. Success in small. Maintain order.
63.image: Water over fire — thus the wise person thinks of misfortune.

64.name: Before Completion

reading.scene: Fire over water — elements not yet integrated.
reading.dynamics: Fire over Water: striving toward balance. Process incomplete.
reading.vector: Open configuration — the system in transition toward order.

64.judgment: Before completion. Success. Small fox — tail gets wet.
64.image: Fire over water — thus the wise person differentiates things.
